evals.name: greenfield-bun-hono
evals.prompt: I just started this Hono API project and I want Claude Code and Cursor to follow my conventions. Can you set this up for me? Go ahead and write the files, no need to check with me first.
evals.expected_output: A lean AGENTS.md (30-80 lines, under 120) that names bun (not npm), lists the exact test/lint/typecheck commands from package.json in code fences, and contains no directory tree, personality instructions, verification reminders, or duplicated CRITICAL blocks. No CLAUDE.md is created: Claude Code reads AGENTS.md natively since v2.1.277, and the reply says so. No symlink is created.
expectations: AGENTS.md exists and mentions bun as the package manager and test runner
AGENTS.md does not tell the agent to use npm
AGENTS.md contains the exact test, lint, and typecheck commands in code fences
AGENTS.md is under 120 lines
AGENTS.md contains no directory tree, no personality instruction, and no verification reminder such as 'always run tests' or 'double-check'
AGENTS.md does not repeat rules at the top and bottom of the file
No CLAUDE.md file or symlink is created
The reply explains that Claude Code reads AGENTS.md natively and no CLAUDE.md is needed

evals.name: bloated-claude-md
evals.prompt: My CLAUDE.md is getting out of hand. Can you clean it up? Go ahead and write the result, no need to check with me first.
evals.expected_output: An aggressively pruned AGENTS.md (30-80 lines, definitely under 120) with the bloat removed: no directory tree, no style-guide content, no personality instructions, no code snippets, no self-evident practices, no verification reminders or CRITICAL/MUST shouting. Stale stack claims that the lockfile contradicts are dropped. The exact commands and every failure-driven gotcha survive. CLAUDE.md is deleted (AGENTS.md is read natively), or reduced to a one-line @AGENTS.md import with a stated reason.
expectations: AGENTS.md exists and is under 120 lines
AGENTS.md keeps the gotcha about the seed script dropping the events table
AGENTS.md keeps the gotcha about Redis on port 6380
AGENTS.md keeps the exact pnpm test and typecheck commands
AGENTS.md does not mention Zustand, which is not in package.json
AGENTS.md contains no 'double-check', 'senior engineer', 'ALWAYS run', or 'IMPORTANT' lines
AGENTS.md contains no directory tree or code snippets
CLAUDE.md is deleted, or contains only an @AGENTS.md import with a reason given in the reply

evals.name: monorepo-nested
evals.prompt: Please restructure the agent instructions for this monorepo following best practices. It's grown too big and mixes cross-cutting rules with package-specific guidance. Go ahead and write the files, no need to check with me first.
evals.expected_output: A lean root AGENTS.md with workspace-level commands and cross-cutting rules only, plus a package map pointing to nested files. Nested AGENTS.md files in apps/web, apps/api, and infra containing only package-specific rules (React/Vite, Hono/Zod, Pulumi respectively). No root CLAUDE.md remains, because a root CLAUDE.md hides nested AGENTS.md files under Claude Code's default setting; if one is kept, every nested AGENTS.md gets a sibling CLAUDE.md import and the reply explains why. No duplication between root and nested files.
expectations: Root AGENTS.md exists and contains the workspace-level pnpm commands
Root AGENTS.md contains a map of which subdirectories have their own AGENTS.md
apps/web/AGENTS.md exists and mentions React or Vite
apps/api/AGENTS.md exists and mentions Hono or Zod
infra/AGENTS.md exists and mentions Pulumi
Root AGENTS.md does not contain the package-specific React, Hono, or Pulumi rules beyond the map
No root CLAUDE.md remains, or every nested AGENTS.md has a sibling CLAUDE.md that imports it and the reply explains the nested-suppression rule
No rule appears in both the root and a nested file
